risks.title: Economic Recession
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in more than 80 countries and is exposed to global economic fluctuations. An economic recession could lead to decreased demand for Linde products. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Linde depends on energy and raw material supply. Disruptions in these supplies could result in lost sales or reduced profitability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of Linde's revenues is denominated in currencies other than the US dollar. Foreign exchange fluctuations could negatively impact Linde's financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: Linde is exposed to credit risks related to its borrowings and investments. An increase in borrowing costs or a reduction in credit quality could negatively impact Linde's financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Linde uses information systems for its operations and is exposed to cybersecurity risks. A security breach could result in loss or disclosure of confidential data. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Linde is subject to regulations in various domains. Changes in these regulations or non-compliance could negatively impact Linde's financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Disaster-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: Linde is exposed to risks related to natural disasters or industrial accidents. Such a catastrophe could result in significant losses and negatively impact Linde's financial results. (default score, to be refined)
